name: La Charrette Bleue
summary: A Drôme Provençale institution on the Nyons road, named after Barjavel’s memoir — generous regional cooking in an old coaching stop.

name: Le Petit Caveau
summary: Nyons’ refined address — seasonal Provençal plates built around local olive oil and Rhône wines, in an intimate stone-vaulted room.

name: Bistro du’O
summary: Creative bistronomy in a vaulted cellar up in Vaison’s medieval Haute Ville — a favourite after a morning among the ruins.

name: L’Oustalet
summary: Gigondas’ celebrated table on the village square — polished cooking with one of the best Rhône wine cellars anywhere.

name: Le Mesclun
summary: Perched in one of France’s prettiest villages, with a terrace looking over the vines — sunny Provençal plates.

name: Le Clair de la Plume
summary: Michelin-level dining at the foot of Grignan’s château — a garden-set special-occasion place; their bistro side is gentler on the wallet.

name: Les Hospitaliers
summary: Hotel-restaurant at the top of a Templar village near Dieulefit — classic cooking and a panoramic terrace over the hills.

name: Cafés under the arcades
summary: The 15th-century arcaded square in Buis is lined with relaxed café-terraces — perfect for lunch or a pastis after a Saint-Julien hike.

name: Terraces on Place des Arcades
summary: Nyons’ arcaded main square fills with café tables — ideal for market-day lunch, ice cream and olive-tasting stops.

name: Village terraces
summary: Small restaurants and café-terraces stacked up the hillside, facing Mont Ventoux — a natural lunch stop before or after the spa.

name: Bistrots de Pays of the Baronnies
summary: A labelled network of village bistros keeping remote Baronnies hamlets alive — simple daily menus, local wine, and the whole village at the bar.

name: Une Autre Maison
summary: Boutique hotel-restaurant in Nyons with a pretty patio — refined southern cooking built on olive oil, herbs and Rhône wines.

name: Coteaux et Fourchettes
summary: A wine-country favourite amid the Cairanne vines — inventive menus with a huge list of southern Rhône crus at fair prices.

name: La Maison Bleue
summary: On the plane-tree square of tiny Villedieu near Vaison — pizzas, salads and long summer evenings on one of the region’s loveliest squares.

name: Crillon le Brave (hotel terraces)
summary: A hilltop hamlet turned luxury hotel facing Mont Ventoux — go for a special-occasion dinner or just a golden-hour drink on the terrace.
